Name: Busty Emily portrait and sprite (CP)
Author: thrintyseven
Description:
Every love booba, right? IT MUST BE.

I love booba, many people made amazing bu-stier version of characters on this site, but so far I didn't see one made for Emily.
So here I am, delivering Booba Gods' will.

*Last attempt I used copyrighted material and got strike (Sorry.), so this time I have remade the portrait base on the original game only. T_T

Hope you enjoy it.

Requirement:
Content Patcher


Installation:
Doesn't have any mod overwrite Emily sprite or portrait already:
1. Download Main mod
2. put the folder inside Stardew Valley/Mods
3. Done

Patch for people who definietly not me uses Xtardew Valley:
1. Download the miscellaneous patch only
2. Make sure you already download Xtardew Valley
3. unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods folder and overwrite Xtardew Valley
4. Done, I hope


Compatibility:
Not compatible with any mod that provide new protrait and sprite for emily.
50% chance you can still get Busty Emily with those all-in-one (portrait/sprite) mod by replacing those mod sprite/Emily.png with my Emily.png.
